title: Rebill Credits and Business Billing Disputes on Small Business Electricity Supply Accounts
content:
## Rules

- When a Small Business Electricity Supply line was billed at more than the policy allows, the over-billed amount is returned as one rebill credit tied to that line, equal to the billed amount minus the correctly computed amount and posted as a negative amount.
- When an energy or monthly service fee line is corrected, the cycle's sales tax line is corrected by its own rebill credit for the tax on the over-billed amount.
- A business line may be corrected only when the business disputes it no later than the plan's dispute lookback months (12 calendar months on every plan) after the line was posted. The lookback ends on the same day of the month 12 months after the posted date, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist; a dispute raised on that last day is inside the lookback.
- Each billed business line may be corrected only once; a rebill credit already tied to the line means it has been corrected.
- A care agent may post a rebill credit up to the plan's agent adjustment limit (250.00 USD on every plan) per line; a larger correction is opened as a business billing dispute for review instead of being posted.
- Under-billing caused by a Beacon Ridge error is not back-billed, and sales tax correctly billed before an exemption took effect is not a billing error.

The posted date of the line and any earlier rebill credit on it are read from the agreement's bill lines.

## Worked correction (hypothetical figures, New Jersey site)

| Line | Billed | Correctly computed | Rebill credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Energy charge | 512.40 USD | 470.10 USD | minus 42.30 USD |
| Sales tax on the over-billed 42.30 USD at 6.625 percent | | 2.802375, rounded half up | minus 2.80 USD |

Each rebill credit is within the 250.00 USD limit, so each is posted.

## Lookback end (hypothetical posted dates)

| Line posted | Lookback ends | Dispute on that day | Dispute the next day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2026 | correctable | not correctable |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025 (no 29 February in 2025) | correctable | not correctable |

## Agent limit at its boundary

| Over-billed amount on one line | Handling |
|---|---|
| 250.00 USD | rebill credit posted by the care agent |
| 250.01 USD | opened as a business billing dispute for review |
